Body.Content:
The ML.NET framework makes machine learning accessible for .NET developers. Develop and infuse custom AI into your applications without expertise in developing machine-learning models. Quickly build models for regression, classification, and clustering. Over time, ML.NET will enable additional tasks and leverage other popular libraries, such as Accord.NET and TensorFlow.

Learn More
